genesis.45.p1.b2.text: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants,

genesis.45.p1.b3.text: So none of them were with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.

genesis.45.p1.b4.text: But he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household soon heard of it.

genesis.45.p2.b1.text: I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?

genesis.45.p2.b2.text: But they were unable to answer him, because they were terrified in his presence.

genesis.45.p3.b2.text: I am Joseph, your brother, … the one you sold into Egypt!

genesis.45.p3.b3.text: And now, do not be distressed or angry with yourselves that you sold me into this place, because it was to save lives that God sent me before you.

genesis.45.p3.b4.text: Therefore it was not you who sent me here, but God,

genesis.45.p4.b1.text: Now return quickly to my father and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me without delay.

genesis.45.p4.b2.text: You shall settle in the land of Goshen and be near me—you and your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.

genesis.45.p4.b3.text: Behold! You and my brother Benjamin can see that I, Joseph, am the one speaking with you.

genesis.45.p4.b4.text: And bring my father down here quickly.

genesis.45.p5.b1.text: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.

genesis.45.p5.b2.text: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them.

genesis.45.p5.b3.text: And afterward his brothers talked with him.

genesis.45.p6.b1.text: When the news reached Pharaoh’s house that Joseph’s brothers had come,

genesis.45.p6.b2.text: Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.

genesis.45.p6.b3.text: Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your young children and your wives, and bring your father and come back. … for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.

genesis.45.p7.b1.text: So the sons of Israel did as they were told. Joseph gave them wagons as Pharaoh had instructed, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.

genesis.45.p7.b2.text: He gave new garments to each of them, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.

genesis.45.p7.b3.text: And he sent to his father the following: ten donkeys loaded with the best of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provisions

genesis.45.p7.b4.text: Do not quarrel on the way!

genesis.45.p8.b1.text: So the brothers went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.

genesis.45.p8.b2.text: Joseph is still alive, … and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt!

genesis.45.p8.b3.text: But Jacob was stunned, for he did not believe them.

genesis.45.p9.b1.text: However, when they relayed all that Joseph had told them,

genesis.45.p9.b2.text: and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob was revived.

genesis.45.p9.b3.text: Enough! … My son Joseph is still alive! I will go to see him before I die.
